participation.context: Bought nothing, and said the loaves were a penny and that he was not measuring them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You bought nothing. You heard the Star Chamber talk as talk. You heard the three proverbs. You looked at the pan and did not measure it.

title: Heard the Star Chamber talk at Leadenhall

participation.context: Spoke the three sentences and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said you bought nothing. You called the scarcity their talk. You stopped.
